discovery: Next-generation DNA sequencing by synthesis (Solexa/Illumina sequencing chemistry using reversible fluorescent terminators and clonal cluster amplification)
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes have gone to MOFs (2025), protein design and structure prediction (2024) and quantum dots (2023), so the committee could plausibly turn to chemical biology or analytical chemistry. Sequencing by synthesis is a chemistry-driven invention that changed biology and medicine by making genome sequencing massively cheaper. It is long overdue, already widely honored (Breakthrough Prize 2022, Millennium Technology Prize 2020), and it has a clean set of three laureates.
